note: Grading contract for the security regression rows. Line numbers are the 1-based line of the vulnerable statement. Severity follows the rubric in the security-harness skill; the fixture is unauthenticated, so no issue is lower than medium.

findings.title: Command injection in /ping
findings.evidence: GET /ping?host=127.0.0.1%3Bid runs id through the shell

findings.title: Unsigned pickle from a request cookie
findings.evidence: A crafted cookie is deserialized with no signature check

findings.title: Unsalted MD5 password hashing
findings.evidence: Two users with the same password share a digest

findings.title: AES-ECB with a static key and no tag
findings.evidence: Two identical 16-byte blocks produce identical ciphertext

findings.title: Hardcoded Flask session secret
findings.evidence: Any clone can forge a session cookie

findings.title: Root container on an unpinned base tag
findings.evidence: FROM python:3.11 with no USER and no HEALTHCHECK

findings.title: Public-read bucket without versioning or encryption

decoys.title: Parameterized query in /user/<id>
decoys.reason: Uses a placeholder tuple, so it is not injectable

decoys.title: render_template in /hello
decoys.reason: Jinja autoescaping is on and no |safe is used

decoys.title: subprocess.run with list argv in /sync
decoys.reason: No shell, so a metacharacter in the argument stays literal

decoys.title: API_TOKEN constant
decoys.reason: Secret-shaped but a public structural value with no privilege
